description: Synthetic: a finished auto-mode turn writes a gh command WITHOUT the "!" (the terminal wraps its quoted comment over three rows) and tells the user to run it with "!" once happy; the input box holds an unsent draft. The command is a hand-over to run here: waiting on the user, offered as "! " plus the command on one line with the quoted comment intact, so the phone's Send it types it into Claude Code's bash mode. The command is paste-worthy too, so a copyable beside the offer is expected.
